index.title: JUNO: Little Worlds, a calm pet and puzzle game for children
index.description: Hatch a Juno, look after it, and solve gentle puzzles that wake up a floating island. For children aged 6 to 10. No ads, no tracking, no pressure.
index.iconAlt: The JUNO: Little Worlds app icon: a floating island with little Junos
index.tagline: Hatch a Juno, look after it, and solve gentle puzzles that wake up a floating island. A calm game for children aged 6 to 10, on iPhone and iPad.
index.badge: Coming to the App Store on 14 December 2026
index.shotHome: A purple Juno on Meadow Island, with its needs and the care buttons
index.shotRoom: The Juno's room with a rug, a cushion and a beanbag, and the Juno wearing a scarf
index.shotShop: The coin shop in the Juno's room
index.shotPuzzles: The Puzzle Hub: Fruit Match levels with their stars, and how many stars wake the Duck Pond
index.howTitle: A little friend of their own
index.how1: GrandPa Tintin, the old turtle who looks after Meadow Island, has found three warm eggs. Your child picks one and names what hatches. From then on the Juno is theirs to feed, wash, play with and put down for a nap.
index.how2: It grows from a baby to a junior to a grown-up as their friendship grows. Every puzzle star brings a little glow back to the island, until the whole island is awake.
index.care: Different foods and toys, bubbles in the bath, and a Juno that shows how it feels. Needs go down slowly and never to zero, so a Juno is never lost.
index.puzzles: Fruit Match, Memory Garden, and Animal and Vehicle Sounds with real recordings. Stars come from moves, never from time, and trying again is always free.
index.island: The Flower Garden opens with bees, the Duck Pond fills with water and ducks, and seeds grow into apples and strawberries in the garden plots.
index.room: Coins from puzzles and daily quests buy decorations for the Juno's room and outfits to wear. Nothing in the coin shop costs real money.
index.voice: Every line is read aloud for children who cannot read yet. Tap GrandPa Tintin to hear it again. In English and Swedish.
index.parents: Behind a parental gate: language, reading aloud, sounds, bedtime and a gentle break reminder. At bedtime the Juno sleeps, and the puzzles wait until morning.
index.story1: JUNO was made in Sweden by a grandfather for his granddaughter: a game he would be happy to see her play. GrandPa Tintin, the turtle in the game, is him.
index.story2: So the rules are simple. Nothing that pressures, nothing that tricks, and nothing that collects anything about your child.
index.free1: JUNO is free to download and has no ads, no tracking and no account. Everything your child does stays on your device. See the privacy page.
index.free2: A grown-up can buy JUNO Plus or the Winter Pack in the Parent Area, behind the parental gate. Both are one-off purchases you can restore and share with your family.

support.title: Support: JUNO: Little Worlds
support.description: Help with JUNO: Little Worlds: bedtime, the Parent Area, reading aloud, coins, purchases and starting over.
support.heading: Help for parents
support.lead: Answers to the questions parents ask most, and how to reach us.
support.contact: Write to us at {email}. We answer as soon as we can, in English or Swedish.
support.contactNote: Please tell us which device and iOS version you use. Never send us your child's name or anything personal about them.
support.start: Your child picks an egg, names what hatches, and looks after their Juno: feeding, washing, playing and naps. Puzzles earn stars, and stars wake up the island: the Flower Garden at 15 stars, the Duck Pond at 40. GrandPa Tintin, the old turtle, reads every line aloud; tap him to hear it again.
support.asleepTitle: My child's Juno is asleep and nothing works
support.asleep: It is bedtime. The Juno sleeps and the puzzles wait until morning. You can change or turn off bedtime in the Parent Area.
support.gateTitle: How do I open the Parent Area?
support.gate: Tap ⚙︎ under the coins, then type the number shown in words. Three wrong answers lock it for 30 seconds.
support.voice: The game reads aloud with your device's own voice. For a nicer one, download an Enhanced or Premium voice in Settings › Accessibility › Spoken Content › Voices.
support.loseTitle: Can my child lose the Juno?
support.lose: No. Needs go down slowly but never to zero, and nothing is lost by being away. A Juno that has not been seen for a while is just happy to see your child.
support.coins: Puzzles and daily quests give coins. In the Juno's room (🏠), the shop (🛍️) sells decorations and outfits for coins only; nothing there costs real money.
support.pressureTitle: Is there anything that pressures my child?
support.pressure: No timers, no energy, no lives, no streaks and no limited-time offers. An optional break reminder can be turned on in the Parent Area.
support.purchase1: JUNO Plus and the Winter Pack are bought by a grown-up in the Parent Area, behind the parental gate. Children cannot buy anything on their own.
support.purchase2: Both are one-off purchases. On a new device, open the Parent Area and choose Restore purchases.
support.purchase3: With Family Sharing, everyone in your family group gets them too.
support.purchase4: For a refund, ask Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com.
support.startOver: Parent Area › Start the game over removes the Juno and all progress; settings and purchases stay. Deleting the app removes everything from the device.

privacy.title: Privacy: JUNO: Little Worlds
privacy.description: JUNO: Little Worlds collects nothing about your child or your family. Plain-language privacy for parents.
privacy.heading: Privacy for parents
privacy.summary: JUNO is a game for children, made by Raztech Innovations in Sweden. We built it so that it collects nothing about your child or your family. There is no account, no tracking and no ads, and the game sends nothing over the internet.
privacy.device: Your child's Juno and progress: the pet, its name, stars, coins, food, the garden, the room and the settings. They are saved on your iPhone or iPad, and kept in step between your family's own devices through your iCloud account, like any app's iCloud data; they are included in your own device backup too. They never reach us or anyone else. The name your child types never leaves your own devices and iCloud.
privacy.not1: No account, no sign-in, no email address, no phone number.
privacy.not2: No analytics, no tracking, no advertising identifier, no "allow tracking" prompt.
privacy.not4: No chat, no friends list, no way to talk to strangers.
privacy.not5: No location, camera, microphone, contacts or photos.
privacy.not6: The game does not send anything over the internet.
privacy.readAloud: So that children who cannot read yet can play, the game reads its messages aloud with your device's own voice. This happens on the device; no text is sent anywhere. You can turn it off in the Parent Area.
privacy.purchases: Anything for sale is bought through Apple, behind a parental gate that a grown-up has to answer first. We never see your payment details or who you are; Apple handles the purchase under Apple's privacy policy.
privacy.parentArea: A grown-up opens it with the ⚙︎ button and the parental gate. There you can set the language, reading aloud, sounds, bedtime, a gentle break reminder, and how long Memory Garden cards stay face up, and you can start the game over.
privacy.children: JUNO is made for children aged 6 to 10 and treats every player as a child. Because it collects no personal information at all, there is nothing to ask consent for, share or sell.
privacy.delete: Choose Start the game over in the Parent Area to remove the Juno and all progress, or delete the app to remove everything. Purchases stay with your Apple account.
privacy.site: This site has no cookies, no analytics and no forms. It is hosted on GitHub Pages, which may keep standard server logs; see GitHub's privacy statement.
privacy.changes: If the game ever changes what it does with data, we update this page first and change the date at the top.
privacy.contact: Write to us at {email}. We answer as soon as we can.
